duration.text: The Business Administration at Shanghai University of Finance and Economics is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 305 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2916 USD/per year ￥ 21000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Personal Photos: Please upload a standard two-inch color photo with a white or blue background. Do not upload black-and-white photos, artistic photos, or selfies. 2. Personal Information Page of Passport: A scanned copy of the personal information page of a regular passport with a validity period later than January 31, 2026 must be submitted. If the current passport's validity does not meet the requirements, please promptly apply for a new passport. For applicants who are unable to obtain a passport before submitting the application due to objective reasons, please contact our school as soon as possible to confirm the alternative supporting documents. 3. Proof of Highest Education: Applicants who have graduated from high school are requested to upload their "Highest Education Certificate (Graduation Certificate)". For current high school graduates, please upload "Expected Graduation Certificate". The "Expected Graduation Certificate" must be issued by the school and should include the date of enrollment and the expected graduation date; if the "Enrollment Certificate" issued by the school contains the above information, it can be used as an alternative. 4. Transcript of all courses completed during the highest academic level: Please upload the complete transcript from the first year of high school up to the time of application. The transcript must be stamped by the school or signed by the relevant person in charge. When submitting the transcript, it is recommended to also provide a description of the grades (including but not limited to the calculation method of GPA and the grading system for course scores). 5. HSK Certificate: The validity period of the HSK score is two years (counting from the date of the examination). 6. Personal Statement: Please write in Chinese. The content should include your personal study plan, no more than 1000 words. It must be signed by the applicant in person. 7. A recommendation letter: In either Chinese or English format, include the name of the recommender's organization, position, contact information, and the recommender's handwritten signature. If the applicant is unable to upload the recommendation letter themselves, please upload the explanatory material in the "Recommendation Letter" section, and the recommender should directly send the recommendation letter to ices@sufe.edu.cn. 8. Criminal Record Certificate: A valid criminal record certificate issued by the local public security authority must be submitted. Generally, it should be a document issued within the past 6 months prior to the application date. 9. Economic guarantee certificate and guarantor's identification document: The economic guarantor must be a natural person with full capacity for civil conduct, over 18 years old, and with a stable source of income; the economic guarantor must truthfully fill out the "Economic Guarantee Certificate" (economic guarantee certificate.pdf), and provide a scanned copy of the original passport cover page (for foreigners) or ID card (for Chinese citizens) of the economic guarantor.

requirements.text: The applicant must be over 18 years old (inclusive) and under 45 years old (inclusive), in good health, comply with the relevant provisions of the "Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China", and be a non-Chinese citizen holding a valid foreign ordinary passport. 2. According to the document No. 12 issued by the Ministry of Education (Educational Department Letter [2020] 12), it is stipulated: If both or one of the applicant's parents is a Chinese citizen and has settled in a foreign country, and the applicant was born with foreign nationality, they should hold a valid foreign passport or nationality certificate for 4 years (inclusive) or more, and have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than 2 years during the last 4 years (from April 30, 2021 to April 30, 2025). One year of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, based on the entry and exit stamps.
